paragraphs: The school fair was on the next Saturday, and the Explorers had a plan. Lily and May drew a plan of the school field. The field was big, and it had two gates. Lily drew the gates first. May wrote the key under the plan. This is what she wrote:
"Plan key. A silver rocket is the photo place. A big wheel is the wheel game. A red car is the racing game. A green face is the mask shop. A blue cup is the water shop."

Lily read the plan to Mia. The plan was easy to read, and Mia liked it. "The north gate is at the top of the plan," said Lily. "The rocket is in the left corner, next to the north gate." "The wheel game is on the left of the field." "The racing game is in the middle." "The mask shop is on the right of the field." "The water shop is next to the south gate."

"How much is a game?" asked Mia. "Each game is five baht," said May. "The rocket is free, and you can take a photo with it." Then Leo came into the library with three green masks. He made them at home with paper and green paint. "They look horrible," he said with a big smile. "That is the idea!" Mia laughed and put one mask on her face. She clapped her hands.

"Where does Leo's shop go?" asked May. Lily looked at the plan again. "It goes on the right of the field," she said. "Look for the green face on the plan." Teacher Kim read the plan. "This plan is easy to understand," she said. The fair starts at nine o'clock, and it finishes at twelve o'clock. Lily put the plan on Explorers' Blog that night.
text.summary: Lily and May draw a plan of the school field for the school fair, and May writes a key. They tell what is where, and Leo brings his horrible masks for one shop.
